claims.statement: For every star T=K_{1,m} with m>=4 and every p satisfying x(T)+2<=p and 3p<2 alpha(T)+1, all m original leaves are favorable and S(T,p)=m*(binom(m-1,p)-binom(m-1,p-1))<0.
claims.scope: Exact symbolic theorem for the star subfamily under the registered lower-region eligibility guards; it does not establish the aggregate for arbitrary ordinary trees.
claims.reason: retained: the independence polynomial, first strict descent, eligibility bounds, strict favorable-leaf test through p=m-1, original deletion operations, all m distinct leaf tags, and the strict summand sign are checked symbolically. The claim is correctly limited to stars and supplies no transport to general trees.

limitations: The exact proof is restricted to stars and does not resolve the registered lower-region aggregate for arbitrary finite ordinary trees.
The optional bipartite tagged-incidence identity and its global deficit budget are not established by this route.
